intro.title: Connect SubDL
intro.summary: Adds subtitle search and downloads for movies and owned TV episodes. A free personal API key is enough to get started.

steps.title: SubDL account
steps.description: Create or sign in to your own SubDL account.
instructions: Open SubDL and sign in or create a free account.

steps.title: API key
steps.description: Open your account panel's API section, generate a key, and enter it here. A paid plan is optional.
instructions: Open Get an API key in the SubDL developer guide.
Generate a personal API key in your account panel.

steps.title: Verify connection
steps.description: Tuvima checks the key and account usage, then saves it for future subtitle requests.

troubleshooting.title: SubDL did not accept this key
troubleshooting.message: Check the API key in your SubDL account panel and try again.
instructions: Generate a new key in your account panel if the old key was revoked.

troubleshooting.title: SubDL quota reached
troubleshooting.message: The account's daily allowance is used up. Try again after it resets.

troubleshooting.title: SubDL is slowing requests
troubleshooting.message: Wait for the retry time before trying again.

troubleshooting.title: SubDL is temporarily unavailable
troubleshooting.message: Your key may still be valid. Try again later.

troubleshooting.title: Tuvima could not reach SubDL
troubleshooting.message: Check this server's internet, DNS, proxy, and firewall settings.

skip_consequences.summary: Embedded and local subtitle files still work; new online subtitles will not be downloaded from SubDL.

credentials.label: SubDL API key
credentials.format_hint: Your personal API key from the SubDL account panel.
